description: Cut silences and filler words (uh, um, este...) from a talking video. Needs a transcript (transcriptionJobId or subtitles) plus the media. Returns the cut MP4, retimed SRT/VTT/JSON and stats (kept and removed seconds, cuts). silenceGapSeconds and paddingSeconds tune cuts; fillerMode clear (default) or aggressive (also like, you know, o sea...); removeFillers:false keeps fillers. burnCaptions:true also burns the retimed captions. Price: 3 credits per kept minute, +4 with burnCaptions; quoteOnly:true prices it free. For highlights use create_clips.

autoFit.description: Default true: caption size, words per caption and a safe zone follow the video shape. false keeps the preset's exact sizes.

brandPresetId.description: Id from manage_preset {action:'create', type:'brand'}: applies its font, color, position and logo on top of the preset.

burnCaptions.description: Burn the retimed captions in the same job.

detectSilences.description: Default true: ffmpeg silencedetect also cuts long pauses.

faceAvoid.description: true = move captions off faces (samples faces at 2 fps, same price; result.faceAvoid.faceLayout). Shortcut for styleOverrides.faceAvoid.

fileId.description: Id of a file already uploaded with upload {action:'start'}, upload {action:'start_multipart'}, upload {action:'inline'} or import_url. Pass this or the media URL.

fillerMode.description: 'clear' (default) cuts only unambiguous fillers (uh, um, er, hmm); 'aggressive' also cuts standalone like, you know, I mean, o sea, bueno...

fillers.description: Extra fillers to always cut, words or phrases.

highlightWords.description: Shortcut: words or phrases to color in every caption (accent/case-insensitive), e.g. ["AwesomeVideo", "gratis"]. Maps to styleOverrides.wordHighlights rule {id:"custom", words, color}; on highlighter-marker, ghost-keywords and brand-box it fills their keyword list in the preset colors. Same price.

maxCredits.description: Spending cap for this call in credits (1 credit = 1 cent). If the price is higher the call fails with 422 before charging.

mediaUrl.description: Public https link to the video or audio (direct file, chat attachment URL, Google Drive or Dropbox share link; YouTube is refused). Pass this or fileId.

paddingSeconds.description: Kept on each side of a cut. Default 0.08.

platform.description: With burnCaptions: tiktok, reels, shorts, ... for safe zones.

preset.description: With burnCaptions: preset id or name (or custom:cp_...). Default Clarity.

quoteOnly.description: Free: return the price for durationSeconds without starting a job or charging (upper bound: every second kept).

removeFillers.description: Default true: cut filler words (uh, um...). false keeps every filler.

silenceGapSeconds.description: Cut pauses longer than this. Default 0.5.

styleOverrides.description: Per-call style changes deep-merged onto the preset (same fields as get_catalog {kind:'presets'} style; null removes a field), validated with the renderer schema and bundled fonts. Example {"fontSize":72,"maxWordsPerCaption":2,"wordEntrance":"bounce"}. Same price. No need to manage_preset {action:'create', type:'custom'}. Every field with examples: get_catalog {kind:'styles'}.

subtitles.description: Existing captions as SRT, WebVTT or AwesomeVideo JSON text. Skips transcription (no transcription charge).

transcriptionJobId.description: Id of a finished transcribe or caption_video job whose transcript to reuse (no new transcription charge).

name: remove_silences

outputSchema.description: A job: poll get_job with id until status is succeeded or failed.

error.description: Failure reason when status is failed.

expiresAt.description: When the result files are deleted.

id.description: Job id: pass it to get_job, resume_job, edit_transcript or as transcriptionJobId.

kind.description: Job kind (transcribe, burn, caption, clips, shorts, trim, dub, translate, preview, metadata...).

result.description: Result when succeeded: url, files[{name, url}], clips, text...

title: Remove silences and filler words
